row: H&B Farm is the realization of a lifelong dream of Jennifer & Matthew Johnson to own a working farm.  Having both been raised on small farms, Jennifer and Matthew have been living in the city for most of their adult lives.  Now comes the chance to return to rural living.  Having completed a renovation to the house, plans to expand the farm into a working farm with chickens, horses, and other animals are not far behind.  Add to that a few crops and you have a recipe for country living at its finest.  Join us as we share our adventures with you!
